details.subject: GRI | Search | Cannons — $1,271 reallocation card
details.dismissedCardTitle: Reallocation opportunity — "GRI | Search | Cannons" at 1.51x ROAS (target 3x) while 1 campaign(s) exceed their targets

preflightResult.1_tof_relevance: FAIL — card treats TOF acquisition campaign as last-click performance line item. Cannons Search runs on unbranded category queries (1,591 of 1,617 top-25 impressions are generic category). Last-click ROAS systematically undervalues this surface.
preflightResult.2_live_and_historical_data: FAIL — card cites 1.51x ROAS only. No 90d nCAC trend, no view-through, no new-customer-share, no recipient-campaign impression-share caps, no cross-campaign auction impact.
preflightResult.3_marketing_intent: FAIL — does not state or reverse-engineer original intent (brand defence on head category terms + TOF acquisition on Max Conv Value).
preflightResult.4_positive_impact_proof: FAIL — "redirect to higher performing campaigns" is vague. No named recipients, no impression-share data, no CPC inflation model.
preflightResult.5_profit_not_revenue: FAIL — $1,271 revenue / $599 CM framing ignores LTGP:nCAC lens. At $125.10 first-order AOV × 47% margin = $58.80 first-order GP, current $55.39 CPA produces +$3.41 first-order CM per acquisition BEFORE LTGP tail.
